study_design: Retrospective analysis of existing fitted predictions and control allocations
prior_inspection: The Norman paper outcomes and a limited anchor top-k diagnostic were inspected before this protocol was written. This is not a prospective or previously blinded validation.

development_margin.grouping: One threshold per budget and reporting gap, pooled over development cases and model pairs
development_margin.threshold: max(gap, maximum absolute anchor margin among development comparisons unsupported across their recorded realizations)
development_margin.release: absolute assessment anchor margin > threshold + numerical_tolerance

rankings.calibrated_margin: absolute assessment anchor margin minus the development maximum margin displacement for its model pair and budget
rankings.no_direction: An anchor margin within numerical_tolerance has no reportable direction. Retained such entries count as unsupported and are enumerated separately.
rankings.area_under_risk_coverage: sum(unsupported_count_at_k / k for k in 1..N) / N

evaluation.unsupported: minimum oriented margin across recorded assessment realizations <= reporting_gap + numerical_tolerance, or anchor direction undefined
evaluation.aggregation: Report comparison counts, per-model-pair composition and equal-unit summaries; preserve each assessment case's declared biological unit
evaluation.uncertainty: Descriptive finite-sample results; no independent-sample confidence intervals over model pairs, cells or control allocations
evaluation.cost: Record per-realization cells and development/assessment realization counts separately; do not infer equal total computation or acquisition cost

Norman.model_panel: All six recorded models and all 15 model pairs
Norman.realizations: All 30 allocations and three input-block choices
Norman.control_pool_relation: Shared control pool; task transfer only

Influenza_heldout_donors.split: Eight original donors for calibration and 39 additional donors for assessment
Influenza_heldout_donors.model_panel: The two model families previously selected within each training group, before additional-donor assessment
Influenza_heldout_donors.prediction_reference: Input block for state predictions; native effects retain their emitted representation
Influenza_heldout_donors.observation_reference: Equal mean of the other two control blocks
Influenza_heldout_donors.metric: Weighted gene-standardized MSE on the recorded training-derived feature axis and scales
Influenza_heldout_donors.seed_aggregation: Score each of the three fitted seeds before averaging their scores
Influenza_heldout_donors.control_pool_relation: Disjoint donor and control-cell membership; shared study and acquisition batches
Influenza_heldout_donors.interpretation: Transfer stress test for frozen reporting thresholds. Each training group has one model pair, so pair-specific margin adjustment cannot change its within-group ranking.
